notes: The JSON supplies only geometry and tensor selectors. qtype is intentionally absent and must come from the GGUF tensor header.
Qwen3.5 is hybrid: layer 0 need not be a full-attention layer. The planner chooses the lowest layer id present in all four q/k/v/o projections with the declared geometry.
One selected full-attention layer is a smoke slice, not evidence that every layer has the same qtype in a mixed Q4_K_M checkpoint.
